---
title: Appendix and supplementary sections
author: Test Author
format:
  mcanouil-typst:
    keep-typ: true
extensions:
  mcanouil:
    type: article
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        description: In a mcanouil article, typst-extras moves the appendix and the supplementary sections to the end, letters the appendix (Appendix A, A.1, Figure A.1, (A.1)), numbers the supplementary floats S1, and keeps the body numbers flat.
        check: bash _checks/extras.sh sections
    mcanouil-typst:
      noErrorsOrWarnings: true
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        - ['#typst-extras-part-start\("appendix"', '#typst-extras-part-start\("supplementary"']
---
